critical_code_review_comments: LinkedUserLedger.jsx — `border-amber-200/60` accent classes are applied to StatTile but the Card component may not surface the border colour without `border` utility (cosmetic only, tiles still render correctly).
routers/invoices.py _notify_linked_user_of_invoice gates on actor.role=='super_admin' — correct per spec; office_admin invoices to a linked client will NOT notify the user (matches PRD).
routers/users.py my_ledger uses `to_list(2000)` for transactions — fine for current scale, consider pagination once a sub-agent crosses ~1k entries.

Filter for excluded auto-mirror transactions runs in Python after fetch (in-memory) — acceptable; could be moved to the Mongo query with `$and: [{linked_invoice_id: {$in:[null]}}]` for slight efficiency.
